checks.name: YOU gives player solidity, not PUSH or visible FALL
Neither/STOP/PUSH/both material truth table
STOP does not anchor or cancel gravity
PUSH objects have default downward gravity
HOVER has no implicit solidity
Hollow objects can share the player cell
Solid/non-solid dynamic overlap is symmetric, not a WIN exception
Terrain supports even non-solid falling objects
Normal direction climbs a PUSH rock without moving it
Push command moves object and player as one group
Failed push of STOP never falls back to climbing
Push mode on empty ground gives flat movement
Mixed word/rock PUSH chains use one contract
Blocked push chain makes no partial moves
Anchored text is not pushable but is climbable
Climbing checks clearance above the starting body cell
Two-cell obstacle cannot be climbed from floor height
Normal movement into a gap falls; it is not a directional jump
Directional jumps absent; in-place jump returns in the same column
Movable words use world gravity
Head bump can raise a PUSH HOVER object
STOP without PUSH cannot be displaced by a head bump
Landing can press a PUSH HOVER object down once
Climbing onto spring is not landing; jump then fall bounces three cells
BOUNCY alone supplies no collision or support surface
BOUNCY consumes landing before downward press
Bounce checks each cell and truncates below a ceiling
Apex permits one clear side-step, never push or climb; rejection preserves apex
Six face neighbors and diagonal do not win
Enter hollow WIN; undo restores the entire winning command
Falling WIN can enter YOU and stops on the winning cell
WIN never overrides solidity supplied by PUSH
YOU WIN on one entity does not win against itself
AND keeps a valid prefix and combines properties
Only same-height +X and +Z sentences parse
Gravity resolves FLY > HOVER > default Down without stale properties
STOP FLY can carry player and stops the group below the ceiling
Camera rotation changes no world state or undo history
IS atomically transfers YOU to another stable ID, without noun transformation
Undo restores controller, implicit solidity and all word positions
YOU+WIN is not same-entity auto-victory
Breaking YOU creates recoverable NoControl, not a hidden fallback robot
Overlap plus control-rule change can win in the same committed atomic group
Losing YOU never silently removes an explicit STOP from the former body
Unimplemented multi-YOU combination is explicit rollback, not arbitrary selection
Unsupported direct controlled HOVER/FLY is diagnosed rather than silently mis-simulated
Transferred body can enter former body; winning undo preserves new control until transfer is undone
Victory never reads interaction metadata or a tutorial-completion counter
No-interaction search filters a real head bump, not only P-prefixed commands
A search limit is inconclusive, never reported as no bypass
Noun conversion preserves ID and cell; applies target properties rather than old PUSH
ROBOT IS FLAG really changes the controlled body; no sticky YOU; NoControl is undoable
Converted body stays controllable only with target YOU; its own YOU+WIN does not win
A global noun sentence affects every matching object, not just the touched instance
A word spelling ROCK is not a ROCK object and never converts with it
Removing a transformation sentence does not reverse completed identity changes
An explicit reverse noun sentence can change the same ID back later
Target HOVER applies immediately before automatic falling
Old noun HOVER is not inherited; converted rock obeys default world gravity
All conversion sources are sampled together; swaps do not depend on entity iteration order
A to B to C is one conversion per entity per accepted command, not transitive closure
Two-way noun cycles alternate on accepted commands, not within one endless transaction
Multiple gravity substeps never convert the same entity a second time in that command
Rejected grounded WAIT does not advance noun conversion or undo history
Camera rotation does not advance noun transformations
Conversion can create a valid WIN pair on already shared coordinates
Victory is checked after the conversion batch; transient old-noun WIN does not latch
Conversion-caused two-solid overlap rolls back the whole command rather than ejecting objects
Conversion respects the existing single-YOU boundary and reports all-or-nothing failure
Conversion does not silently invent direct controlled HOVER flight inputs
Duplicate noun rules do not create duplicate entities or repeated conversions
Different simultaneous target nouns are an explicit conflict, not random choice or cloning
A IS A is a no-op, not a duplication or an implicit transformation lock
Self-identity does not override an explicit different target in this contract
AND may group source nouns for a single target
Noun output fan-out and mixed noun-property RHS have explicit diagnostics
Simultaneous replacement can move control safely; no validation of a temporary half-batch
Conversion changes one existing ID in place; it neither teleports to nor consumes a target instance
Automatic conversion alone is not counted as the required active word/object interaction
Winning undo restores subject identities, control, properties and the victory pair together
